Senior Data Analyst-MS excel (Bangalore Urban)

Company: SWITS DIGITAL Private
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Required: 5+ years

Job Title- Sr. Data Analyst-MS Excel

Experience-5+ years

Location -Bangalore

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting & MIS Analyst with robust hands-on expertise in Advanced Microsoft Excel and Power Query. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of business processes, financial reporting, cost centre management, and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).

The candidate will be responsible for handling complex financial data, consolidating information from multiple sources, transforming data using Power Query, and preparing accurate reports to support business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop, maintain, and automate financial reports using Advanced Microsoft Excel.
 Work with large financial datasets, reporting sheets, and business information to ensure accuracy and consistency.
 Use Power Query for data extraction, cleansing, transformation, consolidation, and analysis.
 Prepare and maintain financial reports related to cost centres, budgets, expenses, and business performance.
 Understand and analyze business processes, financial data, cost centre structures, and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
 Consolidate data from multiple sources and convert complex information into meaningful reports.
 Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure reporting accuracy.
 Analyze financial and business data, identify trends and discrepancies, and provide actionable insights.
 Prepare dashboards, summaries, and management reports for business stakeholders.
 Collaborate with Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand reporting requirements.
 Present analytical findings and communicate insights effectively to stakeholders.
 Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and reduce manual effort through Excel and Power Query automation.

Required Skills & Experience

 Minimum 5+ years of experience working with Advanced Microsoft Excel
 Hands-on experience with Power Query for data transformation, cleansing, merging, appending, and consolidation.
 Strong understanding of business processes and financial reporting.
 Experience working with financial data, reporting sheets, and management reports.
 Knowledge of Cost Centre reporting and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
 Ability to consolidate and present complex business and financial data effectively.
 Excellent stakeholder communication and business understanding. .

Sr. Data Analyst (Bengaluru South)

Company: Stanley Black & Decker
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Required: 7+ years

Position Summary

The Directed Buy Sr Analyst leads and executes directed buy programs across the supply chain, ensuring alignment between OEM/brand requirements, supplier capabilities, and internal procurement strategies. This role is the primary liaison between commodity teams, engineering, operations, and external suppliers  driving cost, quality, and delivery performance across all active directed buy initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

 Identify Directed Buy opportunities at SBD, create a Roadmap and strategy and own the outcomes of the strategy.
 Lead end-to-end management of directed buy programs, including supplier onboarding, contract compliance, and performance tracking.
 Collaborate with commodity managers and engineering teams to align directed buy specifications with sourcing strategies.
 Manage supplier relationships for directed buy components, ensuring adherence to cost targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
 Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, and status reporting for all active directed buy initiatives.
 Identify and escalate risks related to supply continuity, cost overruns, or quality deviations.
 Support RFQ/RFP processes for directed buy commodities in coordination with the commodity excellence team.
 Track savings and value realization from directed buy programs and report results to leadership.
 Ensure compliance with USMCA, tariff, and regulatory requirements for directed buy components.
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the directed buy process.

Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
 7+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain, and project management.
 4+ years experience with Directed Buy program.
 Experience with directed buy or OEM-specified sourcing programs preferred.
 Strong project management skills; PMP certification a plus.
 Proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a quick-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

 Experience in Directed buy program for commodities such as Steel, Resin, packaging etc.
 Familiarity with commodity management frameworks and cost modeling.
 Knowledge of tariff and trade compliance (USMCA, HTS codes).

Here, youll get the unique chance to impact some of the worlds most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Were the Worlds largest tool company. Were industry visionaries. Were solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art smart factory products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

Global Benefits & Perks

What Youll Also Get

jobs_results.title: Project Warranty Data Analyst [RS eLOCO]
jobs_results.description: At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.   Could you be the full-time Project Warranty Data Analyst in Bengaluru we’re looking for?   Your future role Take on a new challenge and apply your data analysis expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, detail-oriented, and innovative teammates. You'll play a key role in ensuring the success of our warranty and performance improvement (PI) activities for metro and locomotive rolling stock. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as engineering, operations, and customer service), analyze technical and financial data, and manage warranty-related information to support decision-making, and much more. You’ll specifically take care of data management and technical analysis, but also provide insights to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. We’ll look to you for:   Managing warranty and performance improvement data for metro and locomotive rolling stock   Conducting technical and financial data analysis to identify trends and actionable insights   Utilizing digital tools such as GSI, Microsoft Office Suite, and SAP for data handling and reporting   Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support warranty activities   Contributing to the development of efficient processes and tools for data management   Providing clear and professional communication to internal and external stakeholders    All about you We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:   Degree in engineering, data analytics, or a related field   1-3 years of experience in metro or locomotive rolling stock warranty or performance improvement activities   Proficiency in data management and analysis   Familiarity with digital tools such as GSI, Microsoft Office Suite, and SAP   Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including English proficiency   Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment   Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset    Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:   Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines   Work with cutting-edge digital tools for data management and analysis   Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues   Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility   Utilise our inclusive and dynamic working environment   Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries   Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning   Progress towards senior roles in data analysis, warranty management, or other areas   Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)      You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!  Important to note As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
